paragraphs.source_en: Before Tokugawa Ieyasu, only three warriors had ever been appointed Chancellor of the Realm: Lord Taira no Kiyomori, Lord Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, and Lord Toyotomi Hideyoshi; and after Ieyasu, there were only two. units.source_en: After having the gifts prepared long beforehand brought out and presented to the daimyos, Ieyasu fell critically ill on the first day of the fourth month in the second year of Genna.
units.source_zh: 让人拿出早就备好的赠礼送与诸大名之后，元和二年四月初一，家康病危。

paragraphs.source_zh: 招待敕使的宴会对于家康已是莫大摧折。让人拿出早就备好的赠礼送与诸大名之后，元和二年四月初一，家康病危。
